## 2. Scope

This module implements:

- The processes whose **Target** is *KMP shared* in section 3 of the referenced FEATURE-MOBILE documents
- The ViewModel, use case, repository, and domain entity components assigned to shared code in the Epic DESIGN

Out of scope:

- Android and iOS UI reduction — see `IMPL-ANDROID` / `IMPL-IOS`
- Kernel services consumed through platform contracts — see the Platform DESIGN
